name: Rethinking Human
tagline: A new story for how humans belong in community and ecosystem
description: Rethinking Human explores how our built systems, economies, and education can be redesigned so people thrive with more time, meaning, and ecological belonging.
contentSubHeading: Designing humane systems for regenerative living

branchFeatures.description: Create practices and places that support human dignity, shared responsibility, and collective learning instead of extraction.
Reimagine time, work, and play so communities can restore rest, participation, and ecological relationship.
Build tools, stories, and learning experiences that make regenerative living easier for families and neighborhoods.

missionTitle: A better human future starts with design
missionText1: We are imagining the systems that support healthy families, meaningful work, and places where nature and culture can grow together.
missionText2: This branch is a call to rethink the rules of housing, education, and community so that people can belong without burning out the planet.
